title: Mexico vs England live: Hosts cut Three Lions' lead as England go down to 10 men
summary: Co-hosts Mexico aim to leave home soil with a bang as they take on Harry Kane’s England in their final game at the iconic Azteca Stadium, the scene of Maradona’s infamous handball 40 years ago, with a place in the World Cup quarter-finals up for grabs. Kick-off in Mexico City was delayed by an hour due to stormy weather. Follow our liveblog for minute-by-mi…
